headline: Apache HTTP/2 RCE CVE-2026-119618 now widely reported; ScreenConnect rogue clients hit 288 endpoints; Barracuda ESG KEV due 11-13

bullets.text: New: The Hacker News now reports the critical Apache HTTP Server flaw CVE-2026-119618 as an HTTP/2 issue that could let unauthenticated attackers execute code remotely, following Wiz's write-up. The brief gives no fixed release.

ScreenConnect attacks using rogue clients have reached at least 288 endpoints across 48 organizations, after earlier reports of MSPs breached through ScreenConnect. N-central remains offline after a researcher published dozens of zero-days (6 outlets).

KEV due 11-13: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (exploited, 4 outlets) and Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935. The 11-12 deadline for OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158, GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex is today.

Still exploited: critical Xen Orchestra flaws (3 outlets); Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 and Openwave CVE-2026-111793 (4 outlets, KEV due 11-24). Outlook CVE-2026-124194 and Chromium CVE-2026-125350 are also due 11-24.

Breaches and ransomware: Maersk confirmed a breach as WhiteArmor demands $5 million; Vanderbilt University on lockdown after ransomware (6 outlets); Credit Mutuel Arkea says €100m missing; Notion says a Fireworks breach exposed customer AI chat transcripts.

State and cloud activity: France blames Iran for sabotage of refrigeration controllers at about 700 retail sites (5 outlets); ESET links Cereal to Turla (5 outlets); AntiFox AI agents used to steal AWS credentials. SITCON 3 holds; week runs 1.06x the 90-day average.

actions: Find internet-facing Apache HTTP Server hosts with HTTP/2 enabled; restrict exposure and patch as soon as a fixed release or distro package ships.
Inventory ScreenConnect instances, remove unknown or rogue clients, patch, and review session and access logs; keep N-central access restricted.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 by 11-13 and hunt for compromise; patch Ivanti Connect Secure.
Confirm OpenSSH, GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex patches are done today, their KEV deadline.
Keep Xen Orchestra off the internet; patch Outlook, Chrome, Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave by 11-24.
Review AWS keys and CloudTrail for unusual use given the AntiFox credential-theft reports.
